facts.fact: The Civil Registration and Identification Act, Act No. 13 of 2024, an act of parliament, is Namibia's statute for civil registration and legal identity, with a Civil Register that includes an Identity Register under a Registrar-General; the document gives no commencement date, so the date is its published date, 2024-12-30.
facts.system: Civil Registration and Identification Act, 2024 (Act No. 13 of 2024)

facts.fact: The Act assigns each person a unique identity number linked to a personal profile, authorises physical or electronic identity documents, and governs authentication and verification of Civil Register data; the date is the document's published date, 2024-12-30.
facts.system: Civil Registration and Identification Act, 2024 (Act No. 13 of 2024)

systems.system: National Civil Register (Birth, Marriage, Death and Identity Registers)
